Jun carrying tea is unrelated to Hugo's admiration of the wooden pieces.

Rosa being in Finn's class has no bearing on Hugo's admiration of the pieces.

If Rosa is in the same class as Finn, and Finn is in the same class as Jun (per other claims), then Rosa would also be in Jun's class, contradicting claim 15 that Rosa is not in Jun's class.

Hugo taking photographs is unrelated to Finn explaining the Sicilian Defense.
